verdicts.rationale: C4 Shoreline's only divergence is energy regeneration, which is constitution-excluded (energy/particles are not modeled) and has no rendered surface on the timeline to diverge from. The burst's actually-rendered surface — the wall summon and its C6 duration extension — is authored correctly. Not implementable: per-hit energy callbacks / onEnergy triggers are on the CANNOT list. Nothing decision-relevant to a rotation is misrepresented.
rubricRefs: CANNOT: out of scope by constitution

groundedIn.claim: The only C4 divergence is energy regeneration per opponent hit, which is unmodeled.
groundedIn.quote: C4 Shoreline: -5 Energy per enemy hit (max 25 from one cast). Authored conceptually but per-hit-energy-callback not modeled.

groundedIn.claim: The burst's rendered surface (wall summon, C6 +5s duration) is authored, so no rendered element diverges.
groundedIn.quote: Spawns 4 walls (Geo construct shields) … 15s base duration extended +5s via C6 (durationModifier on the summon). Authored as a single summon entry 'Wake of Earth Wall' representing the wall set.

verdicts.rationale: A4 forms Crystallize shields, a pickup/reaction-driven mechanic that is out of planner scope. The passive has no authored effects, so nothing renders on the timeline — the absence of a shield window is honest, not a divergence, and there is no surface a player could be misled by. Not implementable: Crystallize shielding is constitution-excluded (pickup-driven empowerment). Curator process-talk only.
rubricRefs: noCaveat: no rendered surface to diverge from
CANNOT: pickup-driven empowerment out of scope

groundedIn.claim: A4 forms Crystallize shields, a mechanic that is out of planner scope and unmodeled.
groundedIn.quote: A4: Wake of Earth shockwaves count as elemental crystals to form Crystallize shields if there are no Geo constructs nearby. Not modeled (Crystallize shielding mechanic is out of planner scope).

groundedIn.claim: The passive's in-game behavior is limited to Crystallize-shield formation, with no other rendered effect.
groundedIn.quote: Wake of Earth's shockwaves count as elemental crystals to form Crystallize shields if there are no Geo constructs nearby.
